# Bound observed-body fixtures

These exact small XML members were retained from the public producer observation
`ca32e6b7b13b3435683c450f81cfc1ea0ae4c0a95694a0cde0d7cf2bc20e5f4c`.
`source-members.json` preserves archive/member coordinates, SHA-256, source
occurrence identities and selected-document disposition. Tests verify the member
digests before using them.

[Immutable release receipt](https://github.com/sondreskarsten/norwegian-laws/releases/download/observation-ca32e6b7b13b3435683c450f81cfc1ea0ae4c0a95694a0cde0d7cf2bc20e5f4c/evidence.json)

Provider: Lovdata. The release attributes the data under
[NLOD 2.0](https://data.norge.no/nlod/no/2.0).

- `lov-1687-04-15.xml`: nested sections, inline links/italics and change annotation.
- `lov-1751-10-02.xml`: mixed content and structured footnote.
- `forskrift-1969-06-27-4.xml`: column-spanning table and two distinct footnotes
  with the same visible label.

These are observed source bodies at the retained 2026 cutoff. Fixture dates do
not assert historical legal states, effective intervals or completeness.
